notes: Phase 2 of mobile touch enhancements: extracted zoom exponent logic into pure function applyZoomExponent(ratio) with exponent 0.3 (up from 0.15). 2x pinch spread now produces ~1.23x zoom (was ~1.11x). World-review identified critical NaN/Infinity guard gap: JavaScript's NaN <= 0 evaluates to false, bypassing the original guard. Fixed with Number.isFinite() check. CropManager.zoomCrop() already has size clamping (min 1px, max image size) but cannot defend against NaN factors — upstream guard is the right layer. All 1333 tests pass across 48 test files.
